chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 246 – Li Huowang Wakes & Faces the Black Tai Sui
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang wakes from a ten-day coma to find his body patched together, the Black Tai Sui secured, and a choice that even he hesitates to make.
og_title: The Black Tai Sui – Chapter 246 of Dao Gui Yi Xian
og_description: Li Huowang forces a smile through his fresh wounds, checks on the captured Black Tai Sui, and nearly takes a bite of raw parasitic flesh—until he stops himself.
twitter_title: Ch. 246: Li Huowang Holds a Piece of the Black Tai Sui to His Lips
twitter_description: Waking from a ten-day coma, Li Huowang finds his scars half-healed, his group alive, and a piece of living, shrieking horror in his hand—ready to bite.

lore_anchors.definition: A parasitic, regenerative fleshy entity rooted in Chinese folk belief; in the Dao-Twisted World, it is a key alchemical ingredient with grotesque, living properties.
A local herder who guided Li Huowang's group out of the wilderness after their cave escape; his family provides shelter and tents.
A region in the Dao-Twisted World, likely referencing a mythological location; the locals show wariness toward Li Huowang’s altered appearance.
The captive from the cave; confirmed alive by Li Huowang before he prioritizes the Black Tai Sui.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Li Huowang stop before biting the Black Tai Sui?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The chapter deliberately leaves his hesitation ambiguous—it could be a moment of clarity, contamination fear, or the horror of his own actions catching up with him.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Black Tai Sui’s significance in this chapter?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is the sole prize Li Huowang dragged out of the cave; he treats it as more important than his own recovery, signaling his shift toward predatory opportunism.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What does the rooftop memory with Yang Na mean?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is Li Huowang’s purest memory of his past life—a promise between teenage lovers—and its destruction symbolizes how the Dao-Twisted World consumes everything he once was.
